Two-year quote total $40,266.05 (2026: $19,690.00 / 2027: $20,576.05, incl. 4.5% Year 2 escalation and 10% OH/G&A/Profit markup), plus an open as-needed line for Senior Consultant remote document prep/planning support ($1,650/day 2026, $1,724.25/day 2027). WOSB certification offered to satisfy WSP's MBE/WBE/SBE/EBE/DVBE/DBE requirement — specific designation not confirmed by WSP.
